subject: 📅 Interview Scheduled — $job_title at $company_name
body:
Dear $student_name,

Good news — an interview has been scheduled for your application. Please add the details below to your calendar and prepare accordingly.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
INTERVIEW DETAILS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Role:            $job_title
Employer:        $company_name
Application ID:  $application_id
Interview Type:  $interview_type
Date:            $interview_date
Time:            $interview_time
Duration:        $duration_minutes minutes
Location:        $location
Meeting Link:    $meeting_link
Interviewer:     $interviewer_name

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

HOW TO PREPARE

  • Research the company, the team, and the role.
  • Re-read your CV/resume and the job description.
  • Prepare 2–3 questions to ask the interviewer.
  • For video interviews, test your camera, microphone, and link in advance.
  • Aim to join 5 minutes early; for on-site interviews, plan your travel.

Need to reschedule or pull out? Reply to this email or contact careers@university.edu as soon as possible — leaving it late reflects badly on you and the University.

Good luck — we're rooting for you!

Kind regards,
University Careers Service
